turns.text: Hello, thanks for coming in. I'm Owen's English teacher.
Hale, I have a client call at 4:40, so I'll be direct. Who decided on the zero, and did anyone speak to Owen before it went in?
Look, I'll own it if I messed up.
"If I messed up." Did you or didn't you, Hale? Nobody called me before that zero went in, and Owen found out on his phone in the middle of class.
Walk me through exactly what I did wrong with Owen's case. Step by step.
You're asking me to walk you through your own mistakes? That's your job, Hale, not mine. Withdraw the zero, and tell me who decided on it.
